sku_type.note: pastagigibayi's dict identity column is sku_type (there is NO sku_type_complete column on this table; the QA table's sku_type_complete is populated from this value). sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Kodomo Toothpaste & Toothbrush 2in1 Zig Zag'), so brand is NOT concatenated again. Exact raw CONCAT with a single-space separator holds on 295/297 production rows; empty sources are NOT skipped, so an empty packsize leaves a trailing space (e.g. 'Big Headed Bird Toothpaste Multi Variant ') and a sub_brand that itself ends in a space leaves a literal double space (e.g. 'Jordan Oral Care Kids Toothpaste  Multi Variant 188 gr'). Reproduce those spaces verbatim - downstream joins are exact-string.

keywords.note: keywords = TRIM(sku_type || ' ' || keywords_typo). Holds on 296/297 rows. keywords_typo is '' (empty string), NEVER NULL, on 180/297 rows; when it is empty, keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type with no trailing space.

packsize.note: Not generated, but strongly conventionalised: '<number> <unit>' with a space, unit lowercase ('45 gr', '50 ml', '42.5 gr'). For bundle_type='multipack' the suffix ' x <n> pcs' is appended ('45 gr x 3 pcs'). Mixed-form bundles join components with ' + ' ('50 gr + 20 ml', '36 gr + 30 pcs'). A pick-your-own/unknown size uses the literal 'Multi Variant'.

_schema_notes.no_meta_column: pastagigibayi_dict has NO _meta column - the harness's '_meta stamped on the new dict row' step cannot be performed here. All 16 columns: keywords, keywords_typo, sku_type, sub_brand, brand, category, sub_category, variant, flavor, flavor_group, age_group, packsize, bundle_type, packaging, company, ingredients.
_schema_notes.filter_table: filter_pastagigibayi has NO `reason` column. Columns: product_id, sku_name, ecommerce_platform, category, sub_category, product_type, merchant_id, url, _meta.
_schema_notes.qa_table: product_id_dict_qa PK is prod_id; identity column is sku_type_complete; also has keywords, brand, sku_name, ecommerce_platform, url, _meta.
